title: Plant Operations Director
text:
Ready to take the helm of a premier 300,000 sq. ft. commercial campus where your operational game plan directly shapes the bottom line?
 

* Pay: $105,000 – $115,000 per year
* Benefits: God-honoring company; Paid time off (Vacation, Sick, 9 Holidays, 2 Floating, 1 Volunteer day); Medical, Dental, and Vision plan options; Life, Accident, and Disability Insurance; HSA/FSA; 401(k) Match; Career Advancement; Free Online Classes; Mental Health & Financial Support; Pay on Demand + Cash Back; English/Spanish Learning
* Location / Work Type: 200 Academy Drive, Front Royal, VA 22630 (On-site; 100% in-office; 0% travel)
* Schedule: Full-Time, Exempt (1st Shift core schedule with 24/7 on-call availability; must live within 40 minutes of the site for emergency response)
* Requirements / Qualifications: 5+ years in physical plant operations; Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent senior experience); hands-on HVAC repair skills; active MEP or industry certifications (IFMA, APPA, BOMA, AFE, or BOMI); background check and drug screening
* Bonuses / Perks: Relocation package available; full operational ownership of a premier multi-building commercial campus; direct leadership of capital upgrades

About The Budd Group
 
The Budd Group is a family-owned, God-honoring facility services company that has delivered excellence across the Southeast for over 60 years . We believe in taking care of our people so they can take care of our customers—fostering a workplace built on integrity, servant leadership, and high performance .
 
What You’ll Do / Key Responsibilities
 
As our Plant Operations Director, you will act as the operational quarterback for a 250,000–300,000 sq. ft. multi-building commercial campus. In this Facilities Manager and Director of Facilities capacity, you will keep every mechanical system running smoothly while coaching a dedicated on-site team:
 

* Lead & Coach the Team: Direct a 6-person crew (Maintenance Technicians, Landscaping Foreman, and grounds staff), setting clear daily standards for preventive maintenance and campus upkeep.
* Own Campus Infrastructure: Oversee mechanical systems and structural integrity across the property, jumping in for hands-on HVAC repairs and troubleshooting MEP systems when needed.
* Drive Capital Projects: Manage facility remodels and site upgrades from start to finish, selecting and negotiating with external vendors and subcontractors.
* Manage Budgets & Executive Partnerships: Serve as the primary Account Manager and trusted partner to the client’s CFO—controlling site budgets, tracking expenses, and mapping out long-term capital plans.
* Protect Operational Readiness: Act as the primary point of contact for after-hours emergency escalations, ensuring rapid, reliable response times.

What You Bring To The Team / Qualifications
 

* 5+ years of senior leadership in physical plant management, multi-building facility operations, or complex commercial account management.
* Bachelor’s degree in Facilities Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or an equivalent combination of senior field experience.
* Active Industry Certifications: Current certifications in MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, or HVAC) and/or recognized credentials from IFMA, APPA, BOMA, AFE, or BOMI (FMP, CFM, SMA, CEFP, etc.).
* Proven success managing commercial budgets, negotiating vendor contracts, and leading capital improvement projects.
* Executive-level communication skills with experience reporting directly to C-suite leaders and CFOs.
* Ability to reside within a 40-minute commute of Front Royal, VA, and pass a pre-employment background check and drug screen.

Why Work For The Budd Group
 

* Executive Compensation & Relocation: Competitive base salary plus relocation support to get you settled in Front Royal.
* Autonomy & Impact: Take true ownership of a premier commercial campus with the backing of a 60-year industry leader.
* Whole-Person Wellness: Robust medical, dental, vision, life insurance, mental health support, and 401(k) matching.
* Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge with vacation, sick leave, 9 paid holidays, 2 floating holidays, and a paid volunteer day.
* Purpose-Driven Culture: Thrive in a God-honoring organization that invests in your personal and professional growth.

The Budd Group Inc. is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law or regulation.
